notes.title: PARTICLE HEARTS IS STEAM DECK VERIFIED!
notes.content:
Great news, Drifters! 

Particle Hearts is now officially Steam Deck verified! 

Something we always loved from our testing was how great Particle Hearts performs on Steam Deck, and how much those beautiful particle colors pop, especially on OLED. 

It sure is great to get that green check mark and make it official, so we wanted to shout about it. 

Enjoy Particle Hearts on the go, and unravel the mysteries of this strange and beautiful land of particles from anywhere. 

- The First Break Labs team

notes.title: We Are In The June Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Particle Hearts is headed to Steam Next Fest!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42613664/d58f823c3f58c5dfcc3c615f0710d7566d744140.png"]



That's right, Particle Hearts will be part of Steam Next Fest, running from June 9th through June 16th!



That means you'll be able to download and play our official demo, get a hands-on feel for the gameplay, and experience a glimpse into the wonderful story we've been pouring our hearts into.



Check out the trailer!

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/IRz33TBn2VM"][/dynamiclink]

Whether you're here for the beautiful yet sinister particle world, the complex puzzles that require manipulating the world around you, or the free exploration of open environments in any way you like, we can't wait for you to jump in and tell us what you think.



💬 On Monday, we'll also be participating in a Dev Interview with the legendary Pirate Software at 11AM PT! Tune in to his stream here: 

[dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/piratesoftware"][/dynamiclink]



More info will be provided on Monday!



👉 Make sure to Wishlist Particle Hearts so you don’t miss the demo drop!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2074740/Particle_Hearts/"][/dynamiclink]

Thanks for all your support—and see you during Next Fest!

- Underwater Fire Games and First Break Labs
